name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: An animated content region that preserves child state while removing hidden content from keyboard navigation and the accessibility tree.
example:
<Button aria-expanded={open} aria-controls="details" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
  Details
</Button>
<Collapsible id="details" isOpen={open}>
  <Input label="Project name" defaultValue="Studio" />
</Collapsible>
